title: Harivamsha
author: vyasa
attributionNote: Traditionally ascribed to Vyasa and transmitted as a supplement to the Mahabharata. Its date and relation to the epic are disputed.
description: The Harivamsha extends the Mahabharata with the genealogy of the Vrishnis and the life of Krishna, from his birth and childhood to his role in the epic. Manmatha Nath Dutt's 1897 prose translation is complete in this edition; the chapter numbering and titles follow the printed translation.
historicalContext: A Sanskrit supplement to the Mahabharata, important for the early development of Krishna devotion. Dutt's translation was produced in Calcutta in the last decade of the nineteenth century.
availabilityNote: Streamed from Project Gutenberg at read time. The translation is complete for the edition; the passage index follows its 137 chapter headings.
